name: Neuro Navigator
description: A 15-episode series on neuro-ophthalmology — optic neuritis, cranial nerve palsies, papilloedema, and the vision changes that signal serious neurologic disease.

episodes.title: The Swinging Flashlight Test: Detecting the Relative Afferent Pupillary Defect
episodes.description: The precise technique, the subtle RAPD in asymmetric optic nerve disease, and the false positives from retinal asymmetry.

episodes.title: Optic Neuritis: The ONTT Findings and the MRI Decision
episodes.description: The classic presentation (young female, pain on eye movement), the Optic Neuritis Treatment Trial, and when MRI dictates MS treatment.

episodes.title: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension: Papilloedema and the Lumbar Puncture
episodes.description: The IIH patient profile (young, female, obese), the modified Dandy criteria, and the visual field monitoring and acetazolamide treatment.

episodes.title: Giant Cell Arteritis: The ESR, CRP, and the 72-Hour Steroid Window
episodes.description: The age-50+ headache patient, the jaw claudication and scalp tenderness, and the immediate high-dose steroid protocol before temporal artery biopsy.

episodes.title: Third Nerve Palsy: Pupil-Sparing vs Pupil-Involving and the Aneurysm Risk
episodes.description: The surgical (pupil-involving) vs medical (pupil-sparing) third nerve palsy, the posterior communicating artery aneurysm emergency, and the diabetic microvascular cause.

episodes.title: Fourth Nerve Palsy: Head Tilt, Cyclotorsion, and the Parks 3-Step
episodes.description: The superior oblique palsy presentation, the Parks 3-step test, and the congenital vs acquired distinction and the head posture.

episodes.title: Sixth Nerve Palsy: The Abducens and Its Long Intracranial Course
episodes.description: Why the sixth nerve is vulnerable to raised intracranial pressure, the microvascular vs neoplastic cause, and the expected recovery timeline.

episodes.title: Horner Syndrome: Ptosis, Miosis, and Anhidrosis — Localising the Lesion
episodes.description: The 3-neuron Horner pathway, the cocaine vs apraclonidine test, and the urgency of ruling out carotid dissection in acute painful Horner.

episodes.title: Thyroid Eye Disease: Proptosis, Diplopia, and the Optic Nerve Risk
episodes.description: The TED phases (active vs inactive), the CAS score, the optic nerve compression red flag, and the role of teprotumumab and selenium.

episodes.title: Optic Disc Edema Differential: Papilloedema, Pseudopapilloedema, and ONHD
episodes.description: Distinguishing true disc edema from pseudopapilloedema (drusen, tilted disc, crowded disc), and the B-scan and OCT confirmation.

episodes.title: Transient Vision Loss: Amaurosis Fugax and the Carotid Workup
episodes.description: The curtain descending description, the embolic vs hemodynamic mechanism, and the urgent carotid Doppler and cardiac workup.

episodes.title: Visual Field Defects: Neurologic Patterns That Localise the Lesion
episodes.description: The chiasmal bitemporal hemianopia, the homonymous hemianopia of retrochiasmal disease, and the localising value of the field pattern.

episodes.title: Nystagmus: Jerk, Pendular, and the Localising Value
episodes.description: Classifying nystagmus (jerk vs pendular, congenital vs acquired), the localising value of gaze-evoked vs downbeat, and when MRI is indicated.

episodes.title: Functional Vision Loss: How to Confirm Non-Organic Visual Loss
episodes.description: The tests that confirm vision is better than claimed (mirror test, optokinetic, fogging), and the empathetic way to manage functional patients.

episodes.title: Headache and the Eye: Migraine, Cluster, and the Red Flags
episodes.description: The migraine visual aura, the cluster headache Horner, and the red flags (thunderclap, positional, awakening) that demand neuroimaging.
